title: Bay 03 rolls out on the diorama's own clip; the first Rotor moves one cell down the lane and onto the cell's lane edge
context: Owner: use the diorama's 8 s roll-out clip for bay 03 when the tank first becomes available, and as the opening when a player skips the story into tower defense. Separately: move the manual-override Rotor one cell further down the wall and place it near the cell edge rather than the centre so fewer rounds hit the ground under the sentry; raise it later if that is not enough.
outcome: A bay with an authored roll-out (bay 03, Tank_Roll_Out, 19 model metres in 8 s, checked against the pinned GLB) makes the first deploy a clip deploy: the deploy's clock scrubs the clip, the parked hull stays on show, the player's hull is hidden and takes over where the clip ends (the plan's run for that bay is the clip's travel). The deploy framing for such a bay sits behind it over the roof, so the blend to the driving view stays behind the hull. The roll-out replays when the bays land after a fresh load if the player has not driven. `defend` tab entry opens stage 8. base-plan walks one lane cell out (KIT.rotorSteps) for the Rotor's wall cell and reports a socket position 0.4 of the way toward the lane (KIT.rotorEdge); the controller places the tower, its wreck and the control shot at the socket position. The story skips the legacy container, relay vault and portal-ring fetches (2.6 MB). Controller unchanged at 17,624 lines.
alternatives: Drive the authored hull with the game's own deploy motion: rejected, the owner asked for the clip.
Raise the Rotor's platform: deferred, the owner's fallback if the edge placement is not enough.
evidence: node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world PASS: bays replay the roll-out (rollingOut, deployBerth 2), bay 3's hull on show while rolling and hidden at hand-over
